text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while happening to pass near the 
fields—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pandorea☆Pandorana! Paphiopedilum☆Insigne!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thou art blessed by Great Nature, little 
sparrow! Turn into a phoenix☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is chanting what sounds like a 
magic spell. ...Yet, nothing seems to be 
happening.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you curious about my magic?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph♪ Well, I suppose I could show you. 
I'm currently practicing transformation 
magic, and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Wait, aaah! My magic sparrow is...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ughh~... And after searching for an entire 
hour to find it, too...
choice_data_list: Let me teach you an amazing spell instead.

Let's go look for the sparrow one more 
time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
An amazing spell? What's that, what kind 
of spell is it...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I said something weird in the heat of the 
moment, but— ...if I recall, there was a 
computer symbol term that sounded like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Semicolon! Apostrophe! Circumflex!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that certainly sounds like a powerful 
spell. ...So, what does it actually do?
choice_data_list: I think... you can get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~. In that case, I'll go test it out by 
beating someone up in the hallway♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho strutted away in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right...! I'll definitely find it and make 
sure your transformation succeeds next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is! All right...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Protea☆longifolia! Paphiopedilum☆callosum!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thou art blessed by Great Nature, little 
sparrow! Turn into a griffin☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing is happening after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? Whyyyy!? What did I do wrong!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She continued chanting incantations until 
the sun went down. ……However, the sparrow 
never transformed.
